fields.title: If schema changes, ignore schema change (deprecated)
fields.description:
If set, the node tries to ignore the changes and outputs a table with the old table specification.
This option is deprecated. Once unchecked, it will disappear and cannot be selected again, as it may lead
to invalid data in the resulting table.

fields.title: If schema changes
fields.description:
Specifies the node behavior if the content of the configured file/folder changes between executions,
i.e., columns are added/removed to/from the file(s) or their types change. The following options are
available:

fields.title: How to combine columns
fields.description: Specifies how to deal with reading multiple files in which not all column names are identical.

fields.title: Append file path column
fields.description:
Select this box if you want to add a column containing the path of the file from which the row is read.
The node will fail if adding the column with the provided name causes a name collision with any of the
columns in the read table.

fields.title: Select sheet
fields.description: Choose which sheet to read from the Excel file. The order of the sheets is the same as displayed in Excel (i.e. not necessarily a lexicographic order).

fields.title: Sheet name
fields.description: The name of the sheet to read.
fields.choicesError: NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "org.knime.ext.poi3.node.io.filehandling.excel.ExcelFileContentInfoStateProvider$ExcelFileInfo.getSheetNames()" because the return value of "java.util.function.Supplier.get()" is null

fields.title: Sheet position
fields.description: The position (starting at 0) of the sheet to read. The maximum position that can be selected depends on the number of sheets available in the first read file.

fields.title: Define read area
fields.description: Choose whether to read the entire sheet or a custom area.

fields.title: Read from column
fields.description: The first column to include specified as label ("A", "B", etc.) or number (starting at 1). Leave empty to read starting at the first column.

fields.title: Read to column
fields.description: The last column to include specified as label ("A", "B", etc.) or number (starting at 1). Leave empty to read until the last column.

fields.title: Read from row
fields.description: The first row number to include (starting at 1). Leave empty to read starting from the first row.

fields.title: Read to row
fields.description: The last row number to include (starting at 1). Leave empty to read until the last row.

fields.title: Define Column Names
fields.description: Choose how to define column names for the table.

fields.title: Header as in row
fields.description: The row number (1-based) containing column names.

fields.title: Prefix for empty headers
fields.description: Prefix to use for empty column headers.

fields.title: Suffix for empty headers
fields.description: Choose the suffix format for empty column headers.

fields.title: Define RowID
fields.description: Choose how to define row IDs for the table.

fields.title: RowID as in column
fields.description: The column (e.g., A, B, C or 1, 2, 3) to use as row IDs. The RowIDs in the selected column must be unique, otherwise the execution fails.

fields.title: Skip empty columns
fields.description: If checked, empty columns of the sheet will be skipped and not displayed in the output. Whether a column is considered empty depends on the Column and Data Type Detection settings: If the cells of a column for all scanned rows were empty, the column is considered empty, even if the sheet contains a non-empty cell after the scanned rows. Removing the limit of scanned rows ensures empty and non-empty columns being detected correctly but also increases the time required for scanning.

fields.title: Skip hidden columns
fields.description: If checked, hidden columns of the sheet will be skipped and not displayed in the output.

fields.title: Skip empty rows
fields.description: If checked, empty rows of the sheet will be skipped and not displayed in the output.

fields.title: Skip hidden rows
fields.description: If checked, hidden rows of the sheet will be skipped and not displayed in the output.

fields.title: Limit scanned rows
fields.description: If you limit the number of scanned rows, only the specified number of input rows are used to analyze the file (i.e. to determine the column types). This option is recommended for long files where the first n rows are representative for the whole file.

fields.title: Maximum number of scanned rows
fields.description: The maximum number of rows to scan for determining column types.

fields.title: Fail if schemas differ between multiple files
fields.description: If checked, the node will fail if multiple files are read via the "Files in folder" option and not all files have the same table structure, i.e. the same columns.

fields.title: Use Excel 15 digits precision
fields.description: If checked, numbers are read in with 15 digits precision which is the same precision Excel is using to display numbers. This will prevent potential floating point issues. For most numbers, no difference can be observed if this option is unchecked.

fields.title: Replace empty strings with missing values
fields.description: If checked, empty strings (i.e. strings with only whitespaces) are replaced with missing values. This option is also applied to formulas that evaluate to strings.

fields.title: Reevaluate formulas in all sheets
fields.description: If checked, formulas are reevaluated and put into the created table instead of using the cached values. This can cause errors when there are functions that are not implemented by the underlying Apache POI library. Note: Files with xlsb format do not support this option. For xlsx and xlsm files, reevaluation requires significantly more memory as the whole file needs to be kept in memory (xls files are anyway loaded completely into memory).

fields.title: On error insert
fields.description: Choose how to handle formula evaluation errors.

fields.title: String
fields.description: The string value to insert into a cell with a formula evaluation error.

fields.title: File encryption
fields.description: Allows you to specify a password to decrypt files that have been protected with a password via Excel. Files without password protection can also be read if you set a password.

fields.title: Password
fields.description: The password to decrypt the Excel file.

fields.title: Enforce types
fields.description:
Controls how columns whose type changes are dealt with.
If selected, the mapping to the KNIME type you configured is attempted.
The node will fail if that is not possible.
If unselected, the KNIME type corresponding to the new type is used.

fields.title: Transformations
fields.description:
Use this option to modify the structure of the table. You can deselect each column to filter it out of the
output table, use the arrows to reorder the columns, or change the column name or column type of each
column. Note that the positions of columns are reset in the dialog if a new file or folder is selected.
Whether and where to add unknown columns during execution is specified via the special row <any unknown
new column>. It is also possible to select the type new columns should be converted to. Note that the
node will fail if this conversion is not possible e.g. if the selected type is Integer but the new column is
of type Double.
